data.title: The page beside the sample
data.goal: Assemble traceable records, distinguish a copied entry from a new test, and explain a limited change to the recording process.

data.situation: By late afternoon, the light had reached the far end of the laboratory bench. Lin sat down to compile the records from the water tests into one file. A bottle stood beside her notebook, its label still damp at one corner. On the screen, page two was followed by page four. She turned back to the paper folder. Page three, with the instrument settings, was missing from the scan. Jo found it beneath a tray and brought it over. Lin scanned it again and kept its page number beside the sample number. Two rows near the bottom of the file had the same sample number, time and reading. “Did we test that bottle twice?” Lin asked. Jo checked the file names and shook her head. She had imported the same file twice. It was a duplicate entry. Lin marked the extra row and added a note explaining how it had appeared. In the compilation she would send to the supervisor, that reading would appear once. The original files stayed in their folder. The downstream result was still different from the upstream one. Before sending the report, Jo wanted to replicate the test. They took another portion from each bottle and followed the same method, using the settings on the recovered page. This time Lin wrote down the start time as Jo worked. The new readings were close to the earlier ones, although they did not match exactly. Lin added the new results on a separate page and wrote that further sampling was needed to explain the difference between the two locations. Before leaving, they tried two ways of arranging the next day's work. Keeping the notebook across the room made Jo walk away from the bench after every test. With the page beside the sample, Lin could enter a result as soon as it was ready. They wanted to optimise the recording process while keeping the test method unchanged. Of the two layouts, the second gave their small team the shortest wait without skipping a check. “Our optimal arrangement for tomorrow,” Jo said, moving the tray away from the papers. Lin closed the folder with every page in order.
data.easySummary: Lin finds a missing page and marks a copied result. The team tests the water again using the same method. They keep the new readings separate and move the notebook beside the sample.
data.easySummaryZh: 林找回缺页，标记了重复的结果。团队用同样方法再测水样，单独记录新读数，再把记录本移到样本旁。

glossary.note: compile the records into one file：把分散的记录汇整成一份文件。
glossary.example: Lin needs to compile the records into one file.
glossary.exampleZh: 林需要把记录汇整成一份文件。

glossary.note: 形容词，放在名词前：duplicate entry。这里是同一文件导入两次形成的多余记录。名词和形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。
glossary.example: The second row is a duplicate entry.
glossary.exampleZh: 第二行是一条重复录入的记录。

glossary.note: replicate the test：以同样方法再次进行实际检测，新的读数可以略有不同。
glossary.example: We will replicate the test using the same method.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们会使用同一方法再做一次检测。

glossary.note: 可数名词，指汇集而成的材料，这里是发给导师的记录汇编。
glossary.example: The compilation contains the checked records from both locations.
glossary.exampleZh: 汇编文件包含两个地点经核对的记录。

glossary.note: optimise the recording process：使记录流程更有效。optimise和optimize是同一动词的两种拼写。
glossary.example: They want to optimise the recording process.

glossary.zh: 在给定条件下最合适的
glossary.note: optimal arrangement：在给定条件下最合适的安排。可用for说明适用的团队或用途。
glossary.example: This is the optimal arrangement for our two-person team.
glossary.exampleZh: 这是最适合我们两人团队的安排。

glossary.note: compile + 信息/记录；into one file说明整理后的载体。本课不指计算机编译。
glossary.example: Lin needs to compile the records into one file.
glossary.exampleZh: 林需要把记录汇整成一份文件。

glossary.note: duplicate作名词前形容词；entry是录入的一条记录。本课说明同一个文件被导入两次，并不是做了两次检测。
glossary.example: The second row is a duplicate entry.
glossary.exampleZh: 第二行是一条重复录入的记录。

glossary.zh: 按同样方法再做一次检测
glossary.note: 重新进行实际检测，随后比较结果；复制文件不能完成这个动作。
glossary.example: We will replicate the test using the same method.
glossary.exampleZh: 我们会使用同一方法再做一次检测。

glossary.note: optimise + process；本故事只调整记录安排，检测方法保持一致。
glossary.example: They want to optimise the recording process.

glossary.note: optimal + 名词；说明对谁、在什么条件下最合适。这里限定为两种布局及两人团队。
glossary.example: This is the optimal arrangement for our two-person team.
glossary.exampleZh: 这是最适合我们两人团队的安排。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The results are in several files, and the scan skips page three. Tell Jo what needs to be done before the report is sent.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 结果分散在几份文件里，扫描还缺了第三页。向乔说明发报告前需要做什么。
acceptableAnswers: We need to find the missing page and compile the records into one file.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: The records need their missing settings page.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 先找回设置记录，再把材料汇整起来。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Jo imported one file twice. Explain why the two rows cannot be treated as two tests.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 乔把一个文件导入了两次。解释为什么这两行不能当作两次检测。
acceptableAnswers: The second row is a duplicate entry; we tested the sample once.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: A duplicate entry does not show another test.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 重复录入的记录不代表另做了一次检测。

retrievalPrompts.cue: The result still looks unusual. Tell Jo how you will check it again without changing the method.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 结果仍显得异常。向乔说明如何在方法不变的情况下再核查一次。
acceptableAnswers: We will replicate the test using the same method and record the new results separately.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Keep the new measurement separate from a copied row.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 新测量单独记录；不要把复制出来的行当作新结果。

retrievalPrompts.cue: One layout puts the notebook across the room. The other keeps it beside the sample and saves waiting time without skipping a check. Explain the choice for tomorrow.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 一种布局把记录本放在房间另一边；另一种把它放在样本旁，省下等待，也不省略检查。说明明天的选择。
acceptableAnswers: Keeping the notebook beside the sample helps us optimise the recording process.
Of the two layouts, this is the optimal arrangement for our small team.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Say what improves and which team the choice suits.
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说明改善了什么，以及这个选择适合什么团队。

transferPrompt.cue: A class tests how fast two types of paper absorb water. One result was entered twice, and the teacher wants another real test. Explain what to do with the records and how to check the result.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 班级测两种纸吸水的快慢。一项结果被录入两次，老师希望真的再测一次。说明如何处理记录，并如何核查结果。
acceptableAnswers: We should mark the duplicate entry and compile the checked records. Then we can replicate the test using the same method and record the new results separately.
transferPrompt.feedback: A second test produces a new result; a duplicate entry repeats an existing record.
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 另一次实际检测会产生新结果；重复录入的行只是已有记录的重复。
checks: 标记重复记录且保留原件
